en.title: S
en.summary: The letter S is the eighteenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is the sound /s/. It makes the sound /s/ in the word (soare) /ˈso̯a.re/, which means sun. This letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Put the tip of your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Leave a narrow space for the air to hiss through. Keep your lips slightly open. Blow air out steadily without using your voice. Touch your neck to check that your vocal cords do not vibrate.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /s/ everywhere it appears. You hear it at the beginning of words and between vowels, as in the word (masă) /ˈma.sə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: In English, this letter often turns into a buzzing sound between vowels, like in the word rose. In Romanian, never buzz it. Always keep it sharp and quiet, like the first sound in the English word sun.
